stays.why: Central and leafy. Close to good restaurants, malls and the road to Golconda. Easy for first-timers.
Upscale dining and nightlife. Quiet streets, good for couples and business travellers.
Modern hotels near the tech offices. Good metro links, but far from the old city sights.
Near the railway station and airport road. Cheaper rooms and a real local feel.

food: Try Hyderabadi biryani: dum-cooked rice with mutton or chicken. Portions are big; one plate often feeds two.
Haleem is the Ramadan favourite, but many places sell it year-round. Slow-cooked wheat and meat, served hot.
Irani chai and Osmania biscuits at old cafés in the old city. Cheap and a local ritual.
Street snacks: mirchi ka salan, lukhmi and samosas near Charminar. Eat where locals queue.
Vegetarian thalis and Andhra meals are easy to find. Ask for less chilli if you are not used to heat.
more_time: Add a day for the Salar Jung Museum and Chowmahalla Palace in the old city.
Ramoji Film City is a full day out. Check tour times and ticket prices on the day.
Swap one city day for a trip to Golconda Fort at sunset, then dinner in Banjara Hills.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the old city, Golconda and a proper biryani crawl without rushing in the heat.

month_notes: January: cool and dry, highs near 28°C. Best month for forts and walking tours.
February: warm days, cool nights, almost no rain. Great for sightseeing.
March: heating up to 34°C. Start early and rest in the afternoon.
April: hot at 37°C. Plan indoor sights and evening outings.
May: hottest month, 37°C highs and humid. Carry water and avoid midday sun.
June: monsoon starts, 18 rain days. Showers are short but streets get messy.
July: wet and cooler at 29°C. Keep a rain plan and flexible timings.
August: still rainy, 18 rain days. Good for museums and food halls.
September: rain continues, 20 rain days. Check forecasts before day trips.
October: rain easing, 13 rain days. Pleasant evenings return.
November: dry and mild at 29°C. Excellent for the old city and bazaars.
December: coolest month, 28°C highs and 17°C nights. Busy and comfortable.

climate_guide.summary: Hot most of the year, with a warm monsoon from June to October. Best months are November to February.

items.title: Best time: November to February
items.text: Highs around 28–31°C and cool nights. Ideal for forts, bazaars and long walks.

items.title: Hot season: March to May
items.text: Highs reach 34–37°C. Sightsee early morning and stay indoors at midday.

items.title: Monsoon: June to October
items.text: 18–21 rain days in the wettest months. Showers are often short; carry a light rain jacket.

items.title: Humidity in the rains
items.text: Sticky days from June to September. Loose cotton clothes help.

items.title: Rain plan
items.text: Keep one indoor backup per day: museums, malls or a long lunch.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light cotton clothes, a hat, sunscreen and a small umbrella for monsoon months. A light layer for December nights.

transit.best: Metro for long hops, ride apps for everything else.

modes.text: Fast and clean. Red, Blue and Green lines, 57 stations, trains every ~4 min. Fares ₹10 to about ₹60 end to end.
TSRTC buses are cheap but crowded. Routes are shown in English too.
Ola and Uber work well. Cabs cannot be hailed on the street, so book in the app.
Agree the fare first. Minimum ₹20 for 1.6 km, then about ₹11/km.
Driving is for the brave. Traffic jams are common at rush hour.
Fine in the old city lanes and around Charminar in cool months. Too hot and spread out elsewhere.
